name: Fritz Haarmann
original_name: フリッツ・ハールマン
source:
Mora's companion and a vampire hunter who is good with various firearms and explosives.  Additionally his skills as a hacker are top notch. Fritz is a cold-hearted and sarcastic man who never fully trusts [url=/c98943]Souta[/url], mainly because the latter is no longer a human being. Basically he treats Souta as a hound to smell out vampires. 

Fritz drives a Hummer, his favorite weapon is the "M4 Witch Hunter Special" (with UV floodlight and bow gun that shoots silver arrows). He is named after a real German serial killer [url=https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Fritz_Haarmann]Fritz Haarmann[/url]. 

[spoiler]Fritz is actually Mora's older brother. Fritz threw himself into a tough battle for her sake. They left their hometown together after Mora was being oppressed and discriminated against due to her being a Dhampir. [/spoiler]

[Translated from [url=https://ja.wikipedia.org/wiki/%E5%90%B8%E8%A1%80%E6%AE%B2%E9%AC%BC%E3%83%B4%E3%82%A7%E3%83%89%E3%82%B4%E3%83%8B%E3%82%A2]Wikipedia[/url].]
